tob-sales-proposal 1.2.2 introduces a new CLI-based, modular HTML proposal generator powered by real sales cases.

- Added CLI entry point, core generator logic, and supporting data files (cases/methodologies).
- Outputs 4-module, brand-styled HTML proposal pages based on client/industry/painpoints input.
- Case and methodology knowledge bases integrated for industry and solution mapping.
- Includes full usage guidance, testing script, and supporting documentation (README).
- Sensitive info is anonymized; only database-backed cases cited—no fabricated examples.

- Major simplification: removed codebase and data files, leaving only documentation.
- Updated SKILL.md with minor edits (eg. "workers" array style, collection name tuning).
- Data, CLI, generator, and supporting files have been removed; now informational/documentation only.
- Guidance and matching logic description remain, but no executable components are included.

- Added package-lock.json for enhanced dependency management.
- Updated core source files: package.json, src/cli.js, src/generator.js.
- General improvements and minor adjustments to the codebase.
- No changes to usage instructions or main functionality.

Initial release: command-line tool for generating ToB sales proposal outlines based on real-case knowledge base.

- Added interactive and quick modes for proposal generation.
- Accepts inputs: client name, industry, pain points, budget, and decision cycle.
- Outputs 4-module Markdown proposal outlines with case references.
- Includes industry-specific case matching and confidentiality handling.
- Provides ready-to-edit template and internal knowledge base integration.
- Documentation and starter data included.

- No changes detected in this version.
- SKILL.md remains unchanged with identical content and usage instructions.

- No changes detected in this version; content, features, and usage remain the same.
- All documentation and usage guidelines are unchanged.

Breaking change: Removed all source code and data files. Skill is no longer executable.

- Removed 8 files, including code, data, and documentation (README.md, package.json, source code, case/methodology data).
- The skill can no longer generate sales proposals, run interactively, or process inputs.
- All references to usage examples, methodology, and case templates are now obsolete.
- This version effectively disables the skill’s core functionality.

ToB销售提案生成器首次发布：

- 自动生成专业的ToB销售提案文档，适用于B2B场景
- 支持客户痛点分析、方案匹配、ROI量化、案例推荐、实施路线图等核心功能
- 提供交互与命令行双模式，支持多参数与RFP输入
- 内置8大提案结构模块和多种行业方法论
- 含7个主流行业案例模板，提升方案输出效率
- 依赖Node.js（必需）和Python（高级分析）
